findings.title: Skilled-floor picker also draws bioferrite plate and any modded constructible floor
findings.detail: The filter (layerable, constructionSkillPrerequisite > 0, designationCategory set, not water or bridge) takes Anomaly's BioferritePlate (Beauty -2, slightly flammable), which is not the stone/tile/carpet/parquet the comment in FurnishRoom describes. It causes no runtime error. If that matters, filtering on a non-negative Beauty stat at the floors query in FurnishRoom would keep it out.

Graphic_Appearances.SubGraphicFor handles null stuff and null appearance by falling back to Smooth, so there is no NRE for the stuffed wall or the def icon (Verse/Graphic_Appearances.cs)
Child linkFlags merge with the parent's Rock/MapEdge; flag lists are OR'd, so the duplicate Rock does no harm (Verse/DirectXmlToObject.cs:115)
BuildingNaturalBase only adds drawerType MapMeshOnly etc., which suits a linked graphic
Powered wall is spawned with blocks, which is never null (BlocksOf ?? BlocksGranite) and stays inside Stony stuffCategories (Source/GenStep_DungeonLayout.cs:79,136)
TerrainGrid.SetTerrain: layerable, temporary and foundation floors are all handled with no error path; TryRandomElement guards an empty floor list
DoTerrainChangedEffects destroys nothing in furnished rooms: Furnish skips them and Skylights only touches caves

requireFloor=false plus placeholder walls on every non-free box cell keeps sketch things off occupied cells
